claims.reason: The two proofs share the same Fubini-swap argument. Both use ext_fun_iff and lintegral_map, expand with lintegral_prod, discharge the measurability side goal with `swap; · fun_prop`, and close with `(lintegral_lintegral_swap ?_).symm; fun_prop`. The comap_prod_swap version adds only simp lemmas for prodMkLeft/prodMkRight. The statement of comap_prod_swap follows from map_prod_swap and comap_prod. Types check. The left side is `comap (prodMkRight α η ×ₖ prodMkLeft γ κ) Prod.swap _ : Kernel (α×γ) (δ×β)`. The right side is `map (prodMkRight γ κ ×ₖ prodMkLeft α η) Prod.swap`, and map_prod_swap rewrites it to `prodMkLeft α η ×ₖ prodMkRight γ κ`. comap_prod needs only IsSFiniteKernel for prodMkRight/prodMkLeft, which instances supply, and it has no extra hypotheses on f beyond measurability. After comap_prod, the goal is `comap (prodMkRight α η) swap _ ×ₖ comap (prodMkLeft γ κ) swap _ = prodMkLeft α η ×ₖ prodMkRight γ κ`. This is definitionally swapLeft_prodMkRight and swapLeft_prodMkLeft, both of which are proved by `rfl`. The refactor needs comap_prod_swap moved after map_prod_swap (currently line 197). Nothing in the file depends on comap_prod_swap, so there is no cycle. The shared lemma is the existing map_prod_swap. The benefit is modest but real: the nontrivial Fubini argument is stated once, and comap_prod_swap becomes a short corollary. I have not checked that the rewrite compiles, so the final `rfl` is an expectation. The `rw [comap_prod _ _ measurable_swap]` step is the one most likely to need adjustment.
claims.shared_lemma: lemma map_prod_swap (κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η] : map (κ ×ₖ η) Prod.swap = η ×ₖ κ  -- existing lemma, reused unchanged; it must be placed before comap_prod_swap
rewritten_uses:
lemma comap_prod_swap (κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel γ δ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    comap (prodMkRight α η ×ₖ prodMkLeft γ κ) Prod.swap measurable_swap
      = map (prodMkRight γ κ ×ₖ prodMkLeft α η) Prod.swap := by
  rw [map_prod_swap, comap_prod _ _ measurable_swap]
  rfl  -- uses swapLeft_prodMkRight / swapLeft_prodMkLeft, both rfl
map_prod_swap is unchanged and remains the only lintegral/Fubini proof.
